chunk_text: UNTRUTHFUL PERSON .. If the 2nd house and its lord are conjunct malefics, the native will be a tale-bearer, will speak untruth and will be afflicted by windy diseases.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 11 - EFFECTS OF THE 2nd HOUSE (Part 2)

chunk_text: The 2nd house and its lord are referred in the matter of windy diseases. Gastric troubles, rheumatism and the like are classified under windy disorders.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 11 - EFFECTS OF THE 2nd HOUSE (Part 2)

chunk_text: If the 2nd house or its lord is associated with Saturn or Mercury it will cause rheumatism and such other disorders.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 11 - EFFECTS OF THE 2nd HOUSE (Part 2)

chunk_text: If Jupiter in affliction is associated with the 2nd house or its lord, gastric troubles will come to pass.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 11 - EFFECTS OF THE 2nd HOUSE (Part 2)

chunk_text: Should the 3rd house be conjunct or aspected by a benefic, the native will be endowed with co-born and be courageous.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 11 - EFFECTS OF THE 2nd HOUSE (Part 2)

chunk_text: The 3rd house specifically deals with the after-born while the 11th house deals with preborn.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 11 - EFFECTS OF THE 2nd HOUSE (Part 2)

chunk_text: In the said chapter the sage instructs us to consider Mars for the 3rd bhava.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 11 - EFFECTS OF THE 2nd HOUSE (Part 2)

chunk_text: In the said chapter the sage instructs us to consider Jupiter for 11th bhava.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 11 - EFFECTS OF THE 2nd HOUSE (Part 2)

chunk_text: Younger sister is denoted by the 3rd house and Mars.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 11 - EFFECTS OF THE 2nd HOUSE (Part 2)

chunk_text: Elder sister by the 11th house and Jupiter.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 11 - EFFECTS OF THE 2nd HOUSE (Part 2)
